contentItem.title: 构造与求解：不可公度量与可公度量与中项无理线段
contentItem.englishTitle: To a straight line which produces with a rational area a medial whole only one straight line can be annexed which is incommensurable in square with the whole straight line and which with the whole straight line makes the sum of the squares on them medial, but twice the rectangle contained by them rational.

revision.changeSummary: Imported Heath source and machine-assisted Chinese draft. No mathematical or editorial review is implied.

surfaces.text: To a straight line which produces with a rational area a medial whole only one straight line can be annexed which is incommensurable in square with the whole straight line and which with the whole straight line makes the sum of the squares on them medial, but twice the rectangle contained by them rational.
直线以有理面积和中项无理线段整条为单位,只有一条直线可以附在后面,正方形的不可公度直线与整条直线,而整条直线则使正方形直线的总数达到中项无理线段,但比有理直线的矩形的总数高出一倍。

Let AB be the straight line which produces with a rational area a medial whole, and let BC be an annex to AB; therefore AC, CB are straight lines incommensurable in square which fulfil the given conditions. [[X. 77](/principles/euclid-10-77)]
让AB线成为有理面积中项无理线段整条线,让BC线成为AB附件;因此,正方形AC线是不可公度线,符合规定的条件。（相关点与线段：CB） [[X. 77](/principles/euclid-10-77)]
I say that no other straight line can be annexed to AB which fulfils the same conditions.
我说,其他直线不能附于符合同样条件的AB线。
For, if possible, let BD be so annexed; therefore AD, DB are also straight lines incommensurable in square which fulfil the given conditions. [[X. 77](/principles/euclid-10-77)]
如果可能的话,BD也列为附件;因此,AD条DB也是符合特定条件的正方形直线不可公度。 [[X. 77](/principles/euclid-10-77)]

Since then, as in the preceding cases, the excess of the squares on AD, DB over the squares on AC, CB is also the excess of twice the rectangle AD, DB over twice the rectangle AC, CB, while twice the rectangle AD, DB exceeds twice the rectangle AC, CB by a rational area, for both are rational, therefore the squares on AD, DB also exceed the squares on AC, CB by a rational area: which is impossible, for both are medial. [[X. 26](/principles/euclid-10-26)]

与前述情况一样,从AD起正方形起DB起超过AC起正方形起AC起CB起CB起7,矩形起AD起DB起AD起DB起2倍以上矩形起AC起AC起AC起CB起CB起,矩形起AD起DB起1 有理面积起AD起AD起CB起有理起正方形起AC起CB起有理面积起有理面积起正方形起正方形起有理面积起有理面积起:两者均不可能,中项无理线段起中项无理线段起中项无理线段起中项无理线段起正方形起AC起CB起有理面积起中项无理线段起中项无理线段起。 [[X. 26](/principles/euclid-10-26)]

Therefore no other straight line can be annexed to AB which is incommensurable in square with the whole and which with the whole fulfils the aforesaid conditions; therefore only one straight line can be so annexed. Q. E. D.
因此,不能将其他直线附在AB之后,即正方形的不可公度整条,而整体上则符合上述条件;因此,只能将一条直线附在后面。
